knowledge:
- key_parameters: PET=indicates single-end (FALSE) or paired-end (TRUE) data ;; fragLen=average fragment length (default 200 bp, ignored for PET) ;; binSize=resolution of bin-level data (default equals fragLen) ;; capping=maximum reads allowed to start at each nucleotide to exclude PCR artifacts (default 0, no capping) ;; bgEst=background estimation approach ('rMOM' for high depth, 'matchLow' for low depth, 'automatic') ;; analysisType=type of analysis ('IO' for input-only two-sample, 'TS' for two-sample with mappability/GC, 'OS' for one-sample with mappability/GC) ;; signalModel=number of signal components ('1S', '2S', or 'BIC') ;; truncProb=proportion of bins not considered outliers in control data (default works well, can be lowered to e.g. 0.80 to improve fit) ;; decoding=decoding method for HMM peak calling ('posterior' or 'viterbi')
- alternatives: CSEM (ChIP-Seq multi-read allocator) can be used to allocate multi-reads into a BED file before running constructBins with fileFormat="csem"
- when_to_use: Use two-sample analysis without genomic features (analysisType="IO") for deeply sequenced ChIP-seq data. Use two-sample analysis with genomic features (analysisType="TS") for low sequencing depth. Use one-sample analysis (analysisType="OS") when a matched control sample is unavailable. Use MOSAiCS-HMM (mosaicsFitHMM/mosaicsPeakHMM) for broad peaks (e.g., histone modifications).
- pitfalls: Automatic background estimation (bgEst="automatic") can sometimes over-estimate background, resulting in too few peaks; explicitly set bgEst="rMOM" or "matchLow" to fix this. Outliers in control data can affect background estimation; lower truncProb (e.g., to 0.80) to improve the fit. Using byChr=TRUE in constructBins requires separate chromosome-wise analysis, whereas byChr=FALSE (genome-wide) is recommended for more stable model fitting. You must run extractReads and findSummit before exporting peaks to narrowPeak or broadPeak formats.

workflows.name: punctuated_peak_calling
workflows.intent: Identify narrow/punctuated peaks (e.g., transcription factor binding) using ChIP and matched control samples without genomic features.
workflows.stages: 1. Construct bin-level files from aligned reads ;; 2. Read bin-level data into R ;; 3. Fit the MOSAiCS model ;; 4. Call peaks ;; 5. Export peak calling results ;; 6. Generate wiggle files for visualization
workflows.code:
constructBins( infile=system.file( file.path("extdata","wgEncodeSydhTfbsGm12878Stat1StdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam"), package="mosaicsExample"), 
    fileFormat="bam", outfileLoc="./", 
    byChr=FALSE, useChrfile=FALSE, chrfile=NULL, excludeChr=NULL, 
    PET=FALSE, fragLen=200, binSize=200, capping=0 )
constructBins( infile=system.file( file.path("extdata","wgEncodeSydhTfbsGm12878InputStdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam"), package="mosaicsExample"), 
    fileFormat="bam", outfileLoc="./", 
    byChr=FALSE, useChrfile=FALSE, chrfile=NULL, excludeChr=NULL, 
    PET=FALSE, fragLen=200, binSize=200, capping=0 )

fileName <- c(
    "wgEncodeSydhTfbsGm12878Stat1StdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam_fragL200_bin200.txt",
    "wgEncodeSydhTfbsGm12878InputStdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam_fragL200_bin200.txt")

binTFBS <- readBins( type=c("chip","input"), fileName=fileName )
fitTFBS <- mosaicsFit( binTFBS, analysisType="IO", bgEst="rMOM" )
peakTFBS <- mosaicsPeak( fitTFBS, signalModel="2S", FDR=0.05, 
maxgap=200, minsize=50, thres=10 )

export( peakTFBS, type="txt", filename="peakTFBS.txt" )
export( peakTFBS, type="bed", filename="peakTFBS.bed" )
export( peakTFBS, type="gff", filename="peakTFBS.gff" )

generateWig( infile=system.file( file.path("extdata","wgEncodeSydhTfbsGm12878Stat1StdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam"), package="mosaicsExample"), 
    fileFormat="bam", outfileLoc="./", 
    byChr=FALSE, useChrfile=FALSE, chrfile=NULL, excludeChr=NULL, 
    PET=FALSE, fragLen=200, span=200, capping=0, normConst=1 )

workflows.name: broad_peak_calling_hmm
workflows.intent: Identify broad peaks (e.g., histone modifications) using ChIP and matched control samples with HMM and post-processing.
workflows.stages: 1. Construct bin-level files ;; 2. Read bin-level data ;; 3. Fit initial MOSAiCS model ;; 4. Fit MOSAiCS-HMM model ;; 5. Call peaks using HMM ;; 6. Extract read-level data ;; 7. Find peak summits ;; 8. Adjust peak boundaries ;; 9. Filter peaks
workflows.code:
constructBins( infile=system.file( file.path("extdata","wgEncodeBroadHistoneGm12878H3k4me3StdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam"), package="mosaicsExample"), 
    fileFormat="bam", outfileLoc="./", 
    byChr=FALSE, useChrfile=FALSE, chrfile=NULL, excludeChr=NULL, 
    PET=FALSE, fragLen=200, binSize=200, capping=0 )
constructBins( infile=system.file( file.path("extdata","wgEncodeBroadHistoneGm12878ControlStdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam"), package="mosaicsExample"), 
    fileFormat="bam", outfileLoc="./", 
    byChr=FALSE, useChrfile=FALSE, chrfile=NULL, excludeChr=NULL, 
    PET=FALSE, fragLen=200, binSize=200, capping=0 )

fileName <- c(
    "wgEncodeBroadHistoneGm12878H3k4me3StdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam_fragL200_bin200.txt",
    "wgEncodeBroadHistoneGm12878ControlStdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam_fragL200_bin200.txt")

binHM <- readBins( type=c("chip","input"), fileName=fileName)
fitHM <- mosaicsFit( binHM, analysisType="IO", bgEst="rMOM" )
hmmHM <- mosaicsFitHMM( fitHM, signalModel = "2S", 
	init="mosaics", init.FDR = 0.05, parallel=FALSE, nCore=8 )
peakHM <- mosaicsPeakHMM( hmmHM, FDR = 0.05, decoding="posterior",
  thres=10, parallel=FALSE, nCore=8 )

peakHM <- extractReads( peakHM,
  chipFile=system.file( file.path("extdata","wgEncodeBroadHistoneGm12878H3k4me3StdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam"), package="mosaicsExample"),
  chipFileFormat="bam", chipPET=FALSE, chipFragLen=200,
  controlFile=system.file( file.path("extdata","wgEncodeBroadHistoneGm12878ControlStdAlnRep1_chr22_sorted.bam"), package="mosaicsExample"), 
  controlFileFormat="bam", controlPET=FALSE, controlFragLen=200, parallel=FALSE, nCore=8 )

peakHM <- findSummit( peakHM, parallel=FALSE, nCore=8 )
peakHM <- adjustBoundary( peakHM, parallel=FALSE, nCore=8 )
peakHM <- filterPeak( peakHM, parallel=FALSE, nCore=8 )

workflows.name: two_sample_genomic_features
workflows.intent: Identify peaks in low-depth ChIP-seq data by incorporating mappability, GC content, and sequence ambiguity.
workflows.stages: 1. Read bin-level data with genomic features ;; 2. Fit MOSAiCS model with TS analysis type ;; 3. Call peaks
workflows.code:
exampleBinData <- readBins( type=c("chip","input","M","GC","N"),
    fileName=c( system.file( file.path("extdata","chip_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample"),
    system.file( file.path("extdata","input_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample"),
    system.file( file.path("extdata","M_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample"),
    system.file( file.path("extdata","GC_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample"),
    system.file( file.path("extdata","N_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample") ) )

exampleFit <- mosaicsFit( exampleBinData, analysisType="TS", bgEst="automatic" )
OneSamplePeak <- mosaicsPeak( exampleFit, signalModel="2S", FDR=0.05,
maxgap=200, minsize=50, thres=10 )

workflows.name: one_sample_genomic_features
workflows.intent: Identify peaks when no matched control sample is available, using genomic features.
workflows.stages: 1. Read bin-level data with genomic features ;; 2. Fit MOSAiCS model with OS analysis type ;; 3. Call peaks
workflows.code:
exampleBinData <- readBins( type=c("chip","M","GC","N"),
    fileName=c( system.file( file.path("extdata","chip_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample"),
    system.file( file.path("extdata","M_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample"),
    system.file( file.path("extdata","GC_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample"),
    system.file( file.path("extdata","N_chr21.txt"), package="mosaicsExample") ) )

exampleFit <- mosaicsFit( exampleBinData, analysisType="OS", bgEst="automatic" )
examplePeak <- mosaicsPeak( exampleFit, signalModel="2S", FDR=0.05,
maxgap=200, minsize=50, thres=10 )

workflows.name: convenient_pipeline
workflows.intent: Run the entire two-sample punctuated peak calling pipeline in a single function call.
workflows.stages: 1. Run the complete pipeline using mosaicsRunAll
workflows.code:
mosaicsRunAll( 
    chipFile="/scratch/eland/STAT1_ChIP_eland_results.txt", 
    chipFileFormat="eland_result", 
    controlFile="/scratch/eland/STAT1_control_eland_results.txt", 
    controlFileFormat="eland_result", 
    binfileDir="/scratch/bin/", 
    peakFile=c("/scratch/peak/STAT1_peak_list.bed", 
               "/scratch/peak/STAT1_peak_list.gff"),
    peakFileFormat=c("bed", "gff"),
    reportSummary=TRUE, 
    summaryFile="/scratch/reports/mosaics_summary.txt", 
    reportExploratory=TRUE, 
    exploratoryFile="/scratch/reports/mosaics_exploratory.pdf", 
    reportGOF=TRUE, 
    gofFile="/scratch/reports/mosaics_GOF.pdf",
    byChr=FALSE, useChrfile=FALSE, chrfile=NULL, excludeChr="chrM",
    PET=FALSE, FDR=0.05, fragLen=200, binSize=fragLen, capping=0,
    bgEst="rMOM", signalModel="BIC", parallel=TRUE, nCore=8 )
